Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Monopoly Go's shelf-complete celebration - the prize shelf glows, the screen dims to a vault, and cash bundles and dice rain down in a physics explosion.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A collectible shelf display under a "SHELF COMPLETED" sign, one shelf glowing gold. The scene dims to a dark vault stage where a green cash stack shows "$55,000,000" and a dice pile shows "600", ending in a full-screen rain of cash bundles and white dice with confetti.

## Motion spec
Pattern: staged reward explosion, ~3s.
- The completed shelf pulses with a golden glow (scale 1 to 1.05, 500ms, twice) while the sign shines.
- The scene dims (300ms) to the dark stage; the cash stack drops in (spring stiffness 320 damping 14) with its amount counting up fast (700ms, ease-out).
- The dice pile materializes below with a small bounce and its count (250ms).
- The explosion: cash bundles burst upward from center (20+ pieces, randomized velocity and spin, gravity pull-down, 1.5s) while dice tumble in from above (15+ dice, physics roll and bounce, 2s) and confetti flutters through both.
- Pieces settle and fade as the rain thins (final 500ms).

## Calibration
- Cash, dice, and confetti run on separate physics timings - layering the three is what reads as abundance.
- The counts tick before the explosion; the rain is celebration, not information.

## Reduced motion
Stage fades in; one gentle confetti fall, no physics burst.

## Don't miss
- The dice show real pips and tumble with rotation - not flat white squares.
- The "SHELF COMPLETED" sign keeps its neon lettering through the dim.
